description.zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见[ListDatasets](~~457222~~)。
description.en: The dataset ID. For more information about how to obtain a dataset ID, see [ListDatasets](~~457222~~).

descriptions.zh:
调用此接口时，需要注意：

- 标签键和值是非空字符串，且长度不能大于128。
- 标签键不能以 aliyun、acs、http://、https:// 开头。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, note the following:

- The key and value of a label must be a non-empty string with a maximum length of 128 characters.

- A label key cannot start with aliyun, acs, http\://, or https\://.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace create-dataset-labels --dataset-id d-lfd60v0p0000ujtsdx --labels example-string --region cn-hangzhou
